title: Payment Services Activity Classifier
description: Reads a caller-declared business model as a closed set of boolean payment-activity facts and classifies it into the licence classes of one of three pinned payment-services regimes: Bermuda’s proposed Payment Services Act (consultation-response status: proposed, never presented as enacted), EU PSD2 Annex I with its Article 3 exclusions, and the UK Payment Services Regulations 2017 Schedule 1 Parts 1 and 2. Considers the regime’s exclusions against the declared facts (technical service providers, one-sided commercial agents, limited-network instruments), reports conflicts such as a declared technology-only model that holds customer funds, and emits transition notes (for example the one-year transition recorded for existing Bermuda money service businesses). Refuses an unknown profile or a missing activities object with a recorded reason, and records non-boolean activity values as rejected inputs. The output is a structured reading of declared facts against pinned primary text, not legal advice: every payload carries not_legal_advice: true.

profile.description: The pinned regime profile to classify against: bermuda_psa (proposed Payment Services Act consultation response), eu_psd2 (Directive (EU) 2015/2366 Article 3 and Annex I) or uk_psrs (UK Payment Services Regulations 2017 Schedule 1).

activities.description: Closed-enum boolean facts declaring the business model. Absent facts read as false; non-boolean values are recorded as rejected inputs.

holds_customer_funds.description: Holds customer funds. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

executes_transfers.description: Executes payment transactions / transfers. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

issues_payment_instruments.description: Issues payment instruments. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

acquires_transactions.description: Acquires payment transactions. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

money_remittance.description: Money remittance. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

initiates_payments_without_holding_funds.description: Payment initiation without holding funds. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

provides_account_information.description: Account information service. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

technical_service_only.description: Technology / technical service only. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

operates_stored_value_wallet.description: Operates a stored-value wallet. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

commercial_agent_for_one_side.description: Commercial agent for one side only. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

limited_network.description: Limited-network instrument. Declared fact about the business model. Absent is read as false.

current_licence.description: Optional: the firm’s current licence where it affects transition notes. msb_2016 = an existing Bermuda money service business under the Money Service Business Act 2016.
